title: 🚨 Be careful!

messages.content:
Your task is to create a storyboard for an animated short film about the importance of recycling event objects.

The storyboard will be provided as plain text, with the following sections:

Title: The title of the novel.
Description: A brief summary of the story.
Characters: A list of characters, each with a `name` and a suggested `voice` (e.g., `name: Koiufeofd, voice: en_lkjfhwkjd`).
Plot: A description of the story's plot points, scene by scene. This section might include dialogue suggestions, but short.
Note: (Optional)

The phrase "Let op!" is a Dutch expression that can be translated to English as "Pay attention!" or "Take notice of" [1]. It is used to warn someone to be careful or to watch out for something [2]. The phrase is often used in a similar way to "Pas op!", which also means "Watch out!" or "Beware!", but "Pas op" is often used in more urgent situations [2]. In essence, "Let op!" is a warning to be careful or pay attention, while "Pas op" is a more urgent warning to watch out for something [2].
